instruction: Adjust the font size of the editor to 16 within VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the editor font size setting to 16 in VS Code. Uses existing check_json_settings metric which checks if settings.json contains the expected key-value pair. The setting 'editor.fontSize' controls the font size in the editor. Agent needs to open settings (UI or JSON) and modify the value to 16.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: getter extracts VS Code settings.json and metric checks for 'editor.fontSize': 16

Metric properly handles the rules dictionary structure: get_rule returns config['rules'] which is {'expected': {'editor.fontSize': 16}}, and metric correctly accesses expected['expected'] to extract the nested expected values
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing font size to 16, evaluator checks exactly that setting
Edge cases handled: metric checks for None/empty results and malformed JSON with try/except
No postconfig needed: settings.json persists after task completion, so verification can read it directly
Static warnings are false positives: get_vm_file can return None but metric handles it (line vscode.py:58-59), and rules dictionary access is correct (line vscode.py:67)
